# InvoiceKit

> InvoiceKit is a free online invoice generator. It works with no signup, runs entirely in the browser (nothing is uploaded) and downloads invoices as PDF. It supports 24 currencies, tax/VAT/GST (including the CGST + SGST split for India), discounts and payment notes. An optional Pro plan ($3.99/month or $24 lifetime) adds a logo, removes the footer, saves clients and invoice history, and unlocks extra designs.

## Tool
- [Free invoice generator](https://invoicekit-coral.vercel.app/): create, preview and download a PDF invoice in about a minute.

## Templates
- [Freelance invoice template](https://invoicekit-coral.vercel.app/freelance-invoice-template): hourly or per-project billing, deposits, payment terms.
- [Photography invoice template](https://invoicekit-coral.vercel.app/photography-invoice-template): session fees, image packages, retainers, usage licences.
- [Contractor invoice template](https://invoicekit-coral.vercel.app/contractor-invoice-template): labor and materials, change orders, progress billing.
- [GST invoice generator (India)](https://invoicekit-coral.vercel.app/gst-invoice-generator): GSTIN, HSN/SAC, CGST + SGST or IGST.
- [UK VAT invoice template](https://invoicekit-coral.vercel.app/vat-invoice-template-uk): 20% VAT and the fields HMRC requires.
- [All invoice templates](https://invoicekit-coral.vercel.app/invoice-templates)

## Key facts
- Price: free for unlimited invoices. Pro is optional.
- Privacy: invoice data stays in the browser's local storage. No account.
- Output: PDF via the browser's Save as PDF.
